chunks: And in the narration of al-Ḥalabī from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام
that ʿAlī عليه السلام used to say: “I do not accept regarding the sighting of the crescent except the testimony of two just men.”

key_terms.الْهِلَالِ: the new moon crescent that marks the beginning of the month
key_terms.عَدْلَيْنِ: upright and just, meeting the standard of probity

ai.seo_question: What testimony is accepted for confirming the sighting of the crescent in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning the establishment of the new lunar month. It states that the sighting of the crescent is not accepted except through the testimony of two just men, highlighting evidentiary rigor in fasting rulings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1912 - In the narration of al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah (as), it is reported that Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), used to say:
"I do not accept the sighting of the crescent except with the testimony of two just men."
